content: Hi, I'm looking into Larkspur Algebra Coaching for my 15-year-old, who has a 58% in Algebra II with the semester final in six weeks. We don’t revisit 8th‑grade material like basic fractions, but we can reinforce those skills within the Algebra II context to close any gaps you’ve noticed.  

Would you like the sessions to focus on boosting confidence and test readiness for the semester final?  

We have a Standard plan (4 × 50‑min sessions / $96 / month) and an Intensive plan (8 × sessions / $176 / month). Enroll by Sunday 22 Nov and the first month is only $72. Sign up here: https://larkspurtutors.example/enroll.  

Any questions?

Great questions! We don’t run a separate 8th‑grade review, but our tutors will spot any foundational gaps (fractions, basic equation solving) while working through the current Algebra II unit and give extra practice to shore them up.

Can you tell me: is there any sample lesson or a tutor-run diagnostic that checks those basics first?
